nextEvent.title: Grand Opening — City Pop, Japanese Future Funk and Cyber Jazz
nextEvent.description:
Celebrate our grand opening with the best tracks of the Japanese Future Funk and City Pop Scene. Dress code: neon. Vibes: maximum synthwave.

Open from 20:00 - 01:00 ST

staff.name: Hikari
staff.about: A Warrior of Light with a passion for photography, music, and the world of Eorzea. Behind VW-82, she brings its vibrant atmosphere to life, capturing the moments and memories that make every night unforgettable.
